name: Jenkins - Pipeline Stage Monitoring
description: The Jenkins - Pipeline Stage Monitoring dashboard provides insights into pipeline performances.
title: Jenkins - Pipeline Stage Monitoring

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Pipeline_Stages
| json "name", "number" as pipeline_name, pipeline_number
| json "stages" as StagesPipeline
| parse regex field = StagesPipeline "(?<json_added_blob>\{[^\}]+(?:\}\}|\}))" multi
| json field=json_added_blob "id", "stageId", "name", "duration", "status", "startTime" as ID, stage_id, stage_name, stage_duration, stage_status, execution_time nodrop
| where pipeline_name matches "{{pipeline_name}}" and  stage_status matches "{{stage_status}}" and  stage_name matches "{{stage_name}}"
| count by execution_time, pipeline_name, pipeline_number,stage_name, stage_status, stage_duration
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Pipeline_Stages
| json "name", "number" as pipeline_name, pipeline_number
| json "stages" as StagesPipeline
| parse regex field = StagesPipeline "(?<json_added_blob>\{[^\}]+(?:\}\}|\}))" multi
| json field=json_added_blob "id", "stageId", "name", "duration", "status", "startTime" as ID, stage_id, stage_name, stage_duration, stage_status, execution_time nodrop
| where pipeline_name matches "{{pipeline_name}}" and  stage_status matches "{{stage_status}}" and  stage_name matches "{{stage_name}}"
| avg(stage_duration) as avg_stage_duration_seconds by stage_name
| sort by avg_stage_duration_seconds

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Pipeline_Stages
| json "name", "number" as pipeline_name, pipeline_number
| json "stages" as StagesPipeline
| parse regex field = StagesPipeline "(?<json_added_blob>\{[^\}]+(?:\}\}|\}))" multi
| json field=json_added_blob "id", "stageId", "name", "duration", "status", "startTime" as ID, stage_id, stage_name, stage_duration, stage_status, execution_time nodrop
| where pipeline_name matches "{{pipeline_name}}" and  stage_status matches "{{stage_status}}" and  stage_name matches "{{stage_name}}"
| json field=json_added_blob "steps" as step
| parse regex field=step "StepName - (?<step_name>.+?),StepStatus - (?<step_status>.+?),StepDuration - (?<step_duration>.+?),StepArguments - (?<step_arg>.+?),StepExecutedOn - (?<step_exec>.+?)\"" multi
| avg(step_duration) as step_duration by pipeline_name, pipeline_number, stage_name, stage_duration, step_name, step_status, execution_time
| num(step_duration) as step_duration_seconds
| sort by step_duration_seconds
| fields pipeline_name, pipeline_number,stage_name, stage_duration, step_name, step_status, step_duration_seconds
| limit 20

panels.title: Top 20 Slowest Pipeline Stages (Seconds) by Pipeline Runs

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Pipeline_Stages
| json "name", "number" as pipeline_name, pipeline_number
| json "stages" as StagesPipeline
| parse regex field = StagesPipeline "(?<json_added_blob>\{[^\}]+(?:\}\}|\}))" multi
| json field=json_added_blob "id", "stageId", "name", "duration", "status", "startTime" as ID, stage_id, stage_name, stage_duration, stage_status, execution_time nodrop
| concat(pipeline_name,"#",pipeline_number) as Pipeline
| where pipeline_name matches "{{pipeline_name}}" and  stage_status matches "{{stage_status}}" and  stage_name matches "{{stage_name}}"| sum(stage_duration) as stage_duration_seconds by stage_name, Pipeline
| order by stage_duration_seconds
| limit 20
| transpose row Pipeline  column stage_name
